text: 你被那尊奇特的偶像吸引，觉得自己非出价不可。你注意到并非只有你如此：僧侣和一名穿深色西装的男人也把各自的报价投进箱子。你希望自己的报价足够高。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 92
text: Something draws you to the curious idol, and you feel compelled to make a bid. You notice that you’re not alone in this, as the monk and one of the dark-suited men both place bids of their own into the box. You hope that yours is high enough.
